# Neuro & Evil Karaoke API — Artists

Base URL: https://api.neurokaraoke.com (Production)

Original artists and their details.

### `GET /api/artists` — List artists

Auth: none

Returns original artists. Supports paging (`startIndex`, `pageSize`, default 30), `search` and sorting (`sortBy`, `sortDescending`).

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `startIndex` | query | `int` | no | default: 0 |
| `pageSize` | query | `int` | no | default: 30 |
| `search` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `sortBy` | query | `string` | no |  |
| `sortDescending` | query | `bool` | no | default: false |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
{
  id?: string | null
  name?: string | null
  summary?: string | null
  content?: string | null
  imagePath?: string | null
  mediaId?: string | null
  songListDTOs?: {
    id?: string | null
    title?: string | null
    opus?: string | null
    oss?: string | null
    cnPath?: string | null
    absolutePath?: string | null
    playCount?: int | null
    duration?: int | null
    streamDate?: date-time | null
    dateAdded?: date-time | null
    coverArtists?: string[] | null
    originalArtists?: string[] | null
    genres?: string[] | null
    coverArt?: {
      id?: string | null
      fileName?: string | null
      contentType?: string | null
      description?: string | null
      isAnimated?: bool
      credit?: string | null
      cloudflareId?: string | null
      mediaStorageType?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Blob, `1` = Cloudflare, `2` = Badge
      absolutePath?: string | null
      artist?: {
        id?: string | null
        name?: string | null
        socialLink?: string | null
        userId?: string | null
        arts?: object[] | null
      }
      upvotes?: int
      tagString?: string | null
      mediaTag?: int  // Possible values: `0` = Neuro, `1` = Evil, `2` = Twins, `3` = Hiyori
    }
    thumbnailArt?: { …same as `coverArt` above }
    order?: int
    hasLyrics?: bool
    userUploaded?: bool
    videoId?: string | null
    hls?: string | null
  }[] | null
  songCount?: int
  newImageBytes?: base64 | null
}[]
```

### `GET /api/artist/{id}` — Get an artist

Auth: none

Returns details for a single original artist.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | path | `string` | yes |  |

### `GET /api/artist/search` — Find an artist by song title

Auth: none

Returns the artist name for the song title given in `title`.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | query | `string` | no |  |

Response `200` OK `application/json`:

```ts
string
```
